## IdentityCollectionReference interface

A deferred collection of explicitly identified objects, bound to the client that decoded it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface IdentityCollectionReference<T, Id = unknown, R extends string = string> extends IdentityCollectionReferenceData<Id, R>, CollectionReference<T, R>
```

**Extends:** [IdentityCollectionReferenceData](./contracts.identitycollectionreferencedata.md)<!-- -->&lt;Id, R&gt;, [CollectionReference](./contracts.collectionreference.md)<!-- -->&lt;T, R&gt;

## Remarks

Its entries are an explicit, ordered list that callers edit by reordering or replacing entries, unlike a selector collection, which callers edit by changing the rule. Its data form is [IdentityCollectionReferenceData](./contracts.identitycollectionreferencedata.md)<!-- -->.
